key_insight: LLM-guided program evolution and researcher generalization yielded an entanglement-assisted quantum code family [[n,1,n−1;n−q−1]]_q, with its underlying algebraic certificate checked in Lean.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline shows how AI-generated constructions can become reusable quantum error-correction designs through exact evaluation, mathematical analysis, and independently checkable evidence.
method: Evolve construction programs with LLM guidance and evaluate outputs exactly.
Generalize finite discoveries to prime powers q≥3 with n≥2q+1, and q=2 with odd n≥5.
Check the algebraic certificate in Lean and certify nonexistence results with DRAT proofs.
evidence_signal: The release includes 115 verified code records and ten DRAT-checked nonexistence results; the family plus entanglement lifting closes 54 archived table gaps, while eight paired generation blocks show held-out success of 46.1%/31.6% versus 19.5%/3.1% at n=13/15.
watch_item: Researcher analysis remains essential: the reported program-evolution gains cover only two unseen lengths and do not establish broad autonomous discovery performance.
paper_title: Researcher-in-the-Loop Evolutionary Discovery of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Code Families
